name: Molecule
definition: A chemical compound recorded in the toxicology dataset, identified by a molecule identifier of the form 'TR' followed by three digits, and carrying a binary carcinogenicity label.
scope: Molecule-level analysis: counting, filtering and classifying compounds.

name: Atom
definition: A single atom belonging to exactly one molecule. Identified by atom_id, which concatenates the parent molecule identifier with the atom's sequential index inside that molecule.
scope: Atom-level analysis and every analysis that counts or filters atoms.

name: Chemical Bond
definition: A chemical bond inside a molecule joining exactly two atoms. Identified by bond_id, which concatenates the parent molecule identifier with the indices of the two joined atoms.
scope: Bond-level analysis: bond counts, bond type distribution, bond-atom membership.

name: Atom Connection
definition: A directional adjacency between two atoms of the same molecule, recorded in the connected table together with the bond_id of the bond that realises the adjacency. Each bond yields two connection rows, one per direction.
scope: Used when the analysis needs 'how many connections or bonds touch an atom', i.e. atom degree or incident-bond counting.

name: Chemical Element
definition: The chemical element that an atom is an instance of, stored as a lowercase element symbol on the atom row rather than as a separate entity table.
scope: Element distribution, element composition of molecules and bonds, and element-based filtering.

name: Bond Type
definition: The order, or multiplicity, of a chemical bond, encoded as a single character. It distinguishes single, double and triple bonds.
scope: Bond order classification and bond type distribution analyses.

name: Single Bond
definition: A chemical bond whose bond type is the single-bond symbol. It is by far the most frequent bond type in the dataset.
scope: Analyses of 'single-bonded' atoms, molecules or bonds.

name: Double Bond
definition: A chemical bond whose bond type is the double-bond symbol. Double bonds are markedly rarer than single bonds and occur only in a minority of molecules.
scope: Analyses of 'double-bonded' atoms, molecules or bonds, and of double-bond molecules.

name: Triple Bond
definition: A chemical bond whose bond type is the triple-bond symbol. It is the rarest bond type, realised by only a handful of bond rows.

name: Carcinogenicity Label
definition: The binary carcinogenicity classification carried by a molecule record. A positive label marks the molecule as carcinogenic and a negative label marks it as non-carcinogenic.
scope: All toxicity-oriented filtering and grouping of molecules.

name: Carcinogenic Molecule
definition: A molecule whose carcinogenicity label is positive.
scope: Subset of molecules used when a question asks for carcinogenic or toxic compounds.

name: Non-carcinogenic Molecule
definition: A molecule whose carcinogenicity label is negative.
scope: Subset of molecules used when a question asks for non-carcinogenic or non-toxic compounds.

name: Atom Index
definition: The sequential position of an atom inside its molecule. It is not stored as a dedicated column but is encoded as the numeric suffix of atom_id after the underscore.
scope: Questions that refer to 'the 4th atom', 'atom 12' or any ordinal atom position within a molecule.

name: Molecule Atom Count
definition: The number of atoms contained in a molecule, obtained by counting the molecule's atom rows.
scope: Molecule size analysis and size thresholds such as 'molecules with more than 5 atoms'.

name: Molecule Bond Count
definition: The number of bonds contained in a molecule, obtained by counting the molecule's bond rows.

name: Element Percentage
definition: The share of atoms of a specified element within a reference set of atoms, expressed as a percentage of the atoms in that set.
scope: Element composition questions such as 'the percentage of carbon in double-bond molecules'.

name: Bond Type Percentage
definition: The share of bonds of a specified bond type within a reference set of bonds, expressed as a percentage of the bonds in that set.
scope: Bond composition questions such as 'the percentage of double bonds in molecule TR008'.

name: Unconnected Atom
definition: An atom that appears in no connection, i.e. an atom bonded to no other atom. Such atoms exist in the atom table but are absent from the connected table.
scope: Questions about atoms that 'cannot bond with any other atoms'.
